name: worktree-hygiene
description: A read-only audit to run at session start: free disk, merged-PR worktrees, idle dependency folders and orphaned dev servers. Proposes removals, never deletes.

worktree_filter.title: Worktree path filter
worktree_filter.description: Only audit worktrees whose path contains this text. Leave empty to audit every entry in git worktree list.

dev_server_pattern.title: Dev server pattern
dev_server_pattern.description: Extended regex matched against process commands to find orphaned dev servers.
